Drop just `idempotent`.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_1WqsrU3YRxyPCaRRUJrg3949","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"content": "import { run, step } from \"zttp:durable\";\nimport { call } from \"zttp:workflow\";\n\nstructural OrderWorkflowProof<T> = Proof<T,\n  | \"deterministic\"\n  | \"retry_safe\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n  | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n>;\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): OrderWorkflowProof<Response> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"idempotency-key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing idempotency-key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    step(\"reserve-inventory\", () => {\n      return Response.json({ reserved: true });\n    });\n    const notified = call(\"notify\", {});\n    return Response.json({ notified: notified.status }, { status: 201 });\n  });\n}\n", "file": "handler.ts"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":31125,"completion_tokens":640,"total_tokens":31765,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":30976},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":223},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":30976,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":149},"system_fingerprint":"a26a7955944dc5c60445bff77fac9c8e"}
